help_banner_seeker_body: Browse our guides to find, filter, and book your perfect property.
help_banner_owner_body: Learn how to list, price, and manage your properties like a pro.
help_guide_start_subtitle: Create your account and explore AqarHub in minutes
help_step_start_1_body: Tap "Create Account" on the login screen, enter your name, email, and password. Verify your email to activate your account.
help_step_start_2_body: Select "User" if you are looking for a property, or "Property Owner" if you want to list units. You can update this later from your profile.
help_step_start_3_body: Go to Profile → Language to switch between Arabic and English. The app updates instantly without restarting.
help_step_start_4_body: Browse available properties on the Home screen, or use the AI Search bar to describe exactly what you need in plain language.
help_guide_search_subtitle: Find the perfect property using filters and AI
help_step_search_1_body: The home screen shows all available properties. Use the chips at the top to filter by Rent, Sale, Furnished, or Bed-only listings.
help_step_search_2_body: Tap the filter icon to narrow by governorate, city, price range, number of rooms, property type, and target audience.
help_step_search_3_body: Tap the AI Search bar and type naturally, e.g. "Furnished apartment in Cairo under 5,000 EGP for a family". The AI reads your request and returns matching listings instantly.
help_step_search_4_body: Tap any card to see photos, video tour, location map, amenities, rental options, and owner contact info. Tap the heart to save it to Favorites.
help_guide_booking_subtitle: Book a full apartment, a single room, or just a bed
help_step_booking_1_body: Some properties offer individual bed rental. On the property details page, tap a bed option under "Rental Options" to see the price and availability, then contact the owner directly via Chat or WhatsApp.
help_step_booking_2_body: Room-only rentals work the same way. Tap the room option in "Rental Options", check availability, and reach the owner through Chat.
help_step_booking_3_body: To rent or buy the full unit, tap "Call", "Chat", or "WhatsApp" on the property details page to negotiate directly with the owner.
help_step_booking_4_body: Use the in-app chat to ask questions, share photos, or request a viewing. A property card is automatically attached so the owner knows which unit you mean.
help_guide_addprop_subtitle: List your unit in minutes with our step-by-step wizard
help_step_addprop_1_body: From your Home or Dashboard screen, tap the floating "+" button to open the Add Property wizard. Fill in the title, property type, governorate, and city.
help_step_addprop_2_body: Upload at least one photo. The first image becomes the cover. Optionally add a short video walkthrough — listings with videos attract significantly more inquiries.
help_step_addprop_3_body: Enter a base monthly price for the full unit. Optionally add per-bed or per-room options for tenants who want to rent a partial unit.
help_step_addprop_4_body: Tap "Analyze My Price" to let the AI compare your listing with the current market. You will receive a suggested price range and a confidence level. A "Verified" badge is added if the price is fair.
help_step_addprop_5_body: Tap "Publish Property". Your listing goes live immediately and appears in search results for all relevant users.
help_guide_manage_subtitle: Edit, update availability, and track your portfolio
help_step_manage_1_body: Open the property card from your Home screen and tap "Edit Property". You can update the description, price, photos, rental options, and amenities.
help_step_manage_2_body: Swipe or tap the toggle on your property card to mark it "Rented". It will no longer appear in search results. Tap again to restore availability.
help_step_manage_3_body: Go to the Analytics tab to see your portfolio value, listing split (rent vs. sale), property type breakdown, monthly trend, and top cities.
help_step_manage_4_body: The Alerts section on your Dashboard highlights properties that need attention — for example fully booked rental options or units overdue for a status update.
help_guide_chat_subtitle: Connect with owners, ask questions, and leave comments
help_step_chat_1_body: Tap the "Chat" button on any property details page or owner profile. A conversation is created with the property card automatically attached, so the owner knows exactly which unit you mean.
help_step_chat_2_body: Hold the microphone button in the chat input bar to record a voice message. Slide left to cancel before releasing.
help_step_chat_3_body: Tap the attachment icon in the chat input bar to send photos or short videos. You can preview and select multiple images before sending.
help_step_chat_4_body: Scroll to the bottom of any property details page to read and post public comments. Comments are visible to all users and help the community share experiences.
help_guide_ai_subtitle: Smart search and automatic price analysis powered by AI
help_step_ai_1_body: On the home screen, tap the AI Search bar and describe what you want in plain text — e.g. "Studio for female students in Giza under 3,000 EGP, furnished". The AI extracts your filters automatically.
help_step_ai_2_body: Results are ranked by relevance. Each card shows whether the AI tagged it as a Great Deal, Verified, Featured, or normal listing based on the price analysis.
help_step_ai_3_body: When adding a property, tap "Analyze My Price" after entering your price and description. The AI returns a market price range, a suggested price, and a confidence level to guide you.
help_guide_account_subtitle: Edit profile, change password, notifications, and language
help_step_account_1_body: Go to Profile → Edit Profile to update your name, phone number, city, date of birth, and profile photo.
help_step_account_2_body: Go to Profile → Security & Password. Enter your current password and a new one. The new password must be at least 8 characters.
help_step_account_3_body: Go to Profile → Notifications to see all your alerts. Tap "Mark all read" to clear the badge counter.
help_step_account_4_body: Go to Profile → Language and tap your preferred language. The whole app switches instantly without needing a restart.
faq_q_create_account: How do I create an account?
faq_a_create_account: Tap "Create Account" on the login screen, fill in your name, email, and password. After signing up, choose your role (User or Owner) and optionally complete your profile with a photo and phone number.
faq_q_change_role: Can I change my role after signing up?
faq_a_change_role: Role changes are managed through your profile settings. Contact support if you need to switch between House Seeker and Property Owner.
faq_q_how_book: How do I contact an owner to book?
faq_a_how_book: Open the property details page and tap "Call", "Chat", or "WhatsApp" to reach the owner directly. There is no automated booking system — all arrangements are made directly with the owner.
faq_q_book_types: What are the different booking types?
faq_a_book_types: Each property can offer three levels of rental: Full Apartment (the whole unit), Room (a private room), and Bed (a single bed in a shared room). Check the "Rental Options" section on the property details page to see which are available.
faq_q_ai_search: How does the AI Search work?
faq_a_ai_search: Tap the search bar on the home screen and describe what you need in plain language. For example: "Furnished apartment in Cairo under 5,000 EGP for a family". The AI extracts filters like location, price, and type, then returns matching properties instantly.
faq_q_favorites: How do I save properties to Favorites?
faq_a_favorites: Tap the heart icon on any property card or details page. To view all saved properties go to Profile → Favorites. You can sort and remove favorites from that screen.
faq_q_add_property: How do I add a property?
faq_a_add_property: Tap the "+" floating button on your Home or Dashboard screen. Follow the step-by-step wizard: enter the title, type, location, specs, photos, price, and optionally run the AI price check before publishing.
faq_a_rental_options: Rental Options let you offer per-bed or per-room pricing in addition to the full-unit price. For example, a 4-bed apartment could be rented as a whole unit for 8,000 EGP/month, or each bed individually for 2,000 EGP/month.
faq_q_ai_price: How does the AI Price Analysis work for owners?
faq_a_ai_price: After entering your property description and price, tap "Analyze My Price". The AI compares your listing with similar properties in the same area and returns a suggested price range and a confidence level. A "Verified" badge is applied if the price is fair; a "Great Deal" badge if it is below market.
faq_q_mark_rented: How do I mark a property as Rented?
faq_a_mark_rented: From your Home screen, open the property card and tap "Mark Rented". The property will no longer appear in search results. Tap "Mark Available" to restore it when it becomes vacant.
faq_a_chat: Tap the "Chat" button on any property details page or owner profile. You can send text, photos, videos, and voice messages. A property card is attached to the conversation automatically so there is no confusion about which unit you are discussing.
faq_a_notifications: Go to Profile → Notifications to see a log of all your alerts. Tap "Mark all read" to clear the unread badge. Push notifications for new messages are sent automatically when the app is in the background.
faq_q_change_language: How do I change the app language?
faq_a_change_language: Go to Profile → Language and select Arabic or English. The language switches instantly across the entire app.
faq_q_change_password: How do I change my password?
faq_a_change_password: Go to Profile → Security & Password, enter your current password, then enter and confirm a new password of at least 8 characters.
